svg.aria-label: Kubernetes DNS: 8 queries or 2. A Pod whose /etc/resolv.conf has ndots:5 and a search list of three cluster suffixes looks up api.github.com through CoreDNS. The search list goes first: api.github.com.default.svc.cluster.local, api.github.com.svc.cluster.local, and api.github.com.cluster.local each get an A and an AAAA query, and CoreDNS answers all six with NXDOMAIN. Only then is the real name api.github.com. forwarded to the upstream DNS on the internet, which answers in 2 queries. Three fixes: a trailing dot, api.github.com., ndots: "2" in the Pod template, and NodeLocal DNSCache on every node.
svg.title: Kubernetes DNS: the ndots:5 search list turns one lookup into 8 queries, and three fixes bring it to 2
